description: Manage spam: list spam folder, report a message as spam, mark as not-spam, or get the spam score of a message. Emails are auto-scored on arrival; high-scoring messages are moved to Spam automatically.

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

limit.description: Max messages to list (for list, default: 20)

name: manage_spam
